   272	# Shared jq definitions: time, the breaker recompute and the run-state resolution
   273	JQ_DEFS='
   274	def epoch: if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) else null end;
   275	def fresh($now; $win): epoch as $t | $t != null and ($now - $t) <= $win and ($t - $now) <= 300;
   276	def recompute($rounds; $reset):
   277	  ($rounds
   278	   | map(select($reset == null or ((.ts // "") > $reset)))
   279	   | sort_by([(.ts // ""), .round, (if .gate == "review" then 0 else 1 end)])
   280	   | map(select(.approved | not))) as $nr
   281	  | reduce $nr[] as $r ({cycle: 0, same: 0, hash: null, np: 0, lc: null};
   282	      .cycle += 1
   283	      | (if $r.hash != "none" and $r.hash == .hash then .same += 1 else .same = 1 | .hash = $r.hash end)
   284	      | ($r.counts | tojson) as $c
   285	      | (if .lc != null and .lc == $c then .np += 1 else .np = 0 end)
   286	      | .lc = $c);
   287	def skeleton($th; $ts):
   288	  {state: "CLOSED",
   289	   triggers: {same_issue: {count: 0, threshold: $th.same, last_hash: null},
   290	              no_progress: {count: 0, threshold: $th.np},
   291	              cycle_count: {current: 0, limit: $th.cycles},
   292	              timeout: {started: $ts, limit_hours: $th.hours}},
   293	   history: []};
   294	def merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts):
   295	  (if type == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
   296	  | .triggers = (.triggers // {})
   297	  | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ([(.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0), $rc.cycle] | max)
   298	  | (if $rc.same > (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0)
   299	     then .triggers.same_issue.count = $rc.same | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $rc.hash else . end)
   300	  | (if $rc.np > (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) or (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts == null and $rc.lc != null)
   301	     then .triggers.no_progress.count = ([(.triggers.no_progress.count // 0), $rc.np] | max)
   302	          | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $rc.lc else . end)
   303	  | ( if (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
   304	        then ["same_issue", "same issue hash repeated \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times (derived from the feedback history)"]
   305	      elif (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
   306	        then ["no_progress", "counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
   307	      elif (.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
   308	        then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
   309	      else null end ) as $trip
   310	  | if $trip != null and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
   311	    then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], source: "derive"}])
   312	    else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end;
   313	def known_ids: (.derivation.sprint_ids // null) // ((.sprints.list // []) | map(.id? // empty));
   314	def resolve($f; $now; $win):
   315	  . as $c
   316	  | (if ($c | type) == "object" then $c else {} end) as $c
   317	  | ($c.state // $c.status // "") as $cs
   318	  | ($c | known_ids) as $known
   319	  | ([$f.sprints[] | select(.state != "complete")
   320	      | "sprint-\(.global_id)" as $g | .local_label as $l
   321	      | select(($known | index($g)) == null and ($l == "" or ($known | index($l)) == null))] | length > 0) as $new
   322	  | ((($c.completion // {}) | .merged_sha? // "") | type == "string" and length > 0) as $merged
   323	  | if ($c.state // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or ($c.status // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or $merged then "JACKED_OUT"
   324	    elif $f.breaker_open or $cs == "HALTED" then "HALTED"
   325	    elif $f.all_complete then "COMPLETE"
   326	    elif $cs == "COMPLETE" and ($new | not) then "COMPLETE"
   327	    elif ($c.timestamps.last_activity? // null) | fresh($now; $win) then "RUNNING"
   328	    else "INTERRUPTED" end;
   329	'

   331	cmd_derive() {

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# run-checkpoint.sh — run position in .run/ (cycle-125 FR-3, SDD D-3.2;
4	# cycle-129 FR-4(f)/FR-5, SDD D-4.6, D-5.1 … D-5.4). Beads are the task ledger;
5	# the checkpoint is a HINT; the run state and the breaker are caches DERIVED
6	# from files (COMPLETED markers, LOA-VERDICT trailers, the ledger, git).
7	#
8	#   run-checkpoint.sh write --sprint sprint-N --phase PHASE [--task BEAD-ID] [--file F]
9	#       Atomically sets .schema_version = 2, .checkpoint = {sprint, task, phase, ts}
10	#       and .timestamps.last_activity = ts: jq → F.tmp.$$ → mv -f, under flock
11	#       on F.lock. F must already exist (a run in progress). Then runs
12	#       `derive --write` (a missing ledger is skipped). Exit 0 · 2 usage /
13	#       no run · 3 write failed (the previous file is untouched).
14	#   run-checkpoint.sh read [--file F] [--json]
15	#       Prints the checkpoint when it is trustworthy: parses, and when a task
16	#       is named, `br show <task> --json` reports it closed (a checkpoint that
17	#       names an open or unknown bead is DISCARDED with a logged line — beads
18	#       remain the recovery source). schema_version 1 / no checkpoint → prints
19	#       "sprint granularity". Exit 0 always when F exists; 2 when it does not.
20	#   run-checkpoint.sh derive [--json] [--write] [--root DIR] [--file F]
21	#       For the ledger's active cycle, per sprint: global_id, local_label,
22	#       ledger status, completed_marker (a2a/sprint-<gid>/COMPLETED exists and
23	#       the feedback trailers name this sprint, as sprint-<gid> or the local
24	#       label; a trailer or a `sprint:` line naming another sprint makes it a
25	#       stale_marker, treated as absent), review/audit verdicts (verdict-derive.sh;
26	#       APPROVED needs exit 0; a file without a trailer is legacy: no verdict,
27	#       listed in derivation.legacy_feedback), impl_commit (newest non-merge
28	#       commit on HEAD since max(sprint started|created, cycle created) touching
29	#       a path outside grimoires/, .run/, REPO-MAP.md, checksums.json,
30	#       CHANGELOG.md) and state complete | awaiting_marker | in_progress.
31	#       Run state, first match wins:
32	#         cache .state or .status JACKED_OUT, or .completion.merged_sha → JACKED_OUT (terminal)
33	#         breaker OPEN, or cache HALTED                                 → HALTED (sticky until /run-resume)
34	#         every sprint complete                                         → COMPLETE
35	#         cache COMPLETE and the ledger registers no new incomplete sprint → COMPLETE
36	#         last_activity within run_mode.stale_hours (12)                → RUNNING
37	#         otherwise                                                     → INTERRUPTED
38	#       Breaker (active sprint = first incomplete, else the last): the ordered
39	#       rounds engineer-feedback-r*.md, auditor-sprint-feedback-r*.md and the
40	#       current files (sorted by trailer ts, round, gate; rounds before the
41	#       breaker's reset_at are ignored) give cycle_count (non-APPROVED rounds),
42	#       same_issue (consecutive equal hashes) and no_progress (consecutive
43	#       equal counts); each cached counter is raised to its recomputed value,
44	#       never lowered; OPEN when a count threshold is met (timeout is left to
45	#       record-round). --json prints the derivation; --write rewrites F
46	#       (.state canonical, .status mirrored, derived_at, derivation {source,
47	#       stale_markers, legacy_feedback, sprint_ids}; schema_version kept) and
48	#       the breaker, under their locks — only when F exists, parses, and
49	#       run_mode.file_authoritative is not false (false = report-only).
50	#       Exit 0 · 4 no ledger / no active cycle · 2 usage.
51	#   run-checkpoint.sh record-round --gate review|audit --file FEEDBACK [--sprint sprint-N]
52	#                                  [--state-file F] [--breaker B]
53	#       After a review or audit: verdict-derive.sh --json on FEEDBACK; the
54	#       same-issue hash is md5 of `jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}'` of that output
55	#       (no trailer: md5 of the first 50 lines from ## Findings / ## Issues /

141	# atomic_update FILE JQ-ARGS... — jq over FILE (or {} when FILE is absent) →
142	# FILE.tmp.$$ → mv -f, under flock on FILE.lock. Exit 3 on any failure; the
143	# previous file is untouched.
144	atomic_update() {
145	  local f="$1"; shift
146	  local tmp="$f.tmp.$$" rc=0
147	  (
148	    # flock is util-linux (Linux); without it (macOS) the write is still atomic
149	    # (tmp + mv) but concurrent writers may interleave — last writer wins.
150	    if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then flock -w 5 9 || { echo "run-checkpoint: lock timeout on $f.lock" >&2; exit 3; }; fi
151	    if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then
152	      jq "$@" "$f" > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: $f is not valid JSON — not written" >&2; exit 3; }
153	    else
154	      jq "$@" <<<'{}' > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: could not build $f" >&2; exit 3; }

156	    jq -e . "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: refusing to replace $f with unparseable output" >&2; exit 3; }

158	  ) 9>"$f.lock" || rc=$?

214	# fb_parse FILE GATE → one compact JSON object: {file, exists, trailer, verdict,

216	# same-issue hash (md5 of `jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}'` over verdict-derive's
217	# --json output; legacy files hash their findings section).
218	fb_parse() {
219	  local f="$1" g="$2" rel vj tl pj hash
220	  rel="${f#"$root"/}"
221	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then jq -nc --arg f "$rel" '{file: $f, exists: false}'; return 0; fi
222	  vj=$(bash "$VERDICT_DERIVE" --file "$f" --gate "$g" --json 2>/dev/null) || true
223	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$vj" || vj='{"trailer_found":false,"verdict":null,"counts":null,"exit_code":1}'
224	  tl=$(grep -E '^<!-- LOA-VERDICT \{.*\} -->[[:space:]]*$' "$f" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1) || tl=""
225	  pj=$(printf '%s' "$tl" | sed -E 's/^<!-- LOA-VERDICT (.*) -->[[:space:]]*$/\1/')
226	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$pj" || pj='{}'
227	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.trailer_found' <<<"$vj")" == true ]]; then
228	    hash=$(printf '%s\n' "$vj" | jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}' | _md5)
229	  else
230	    hash=$( { grep -A 100 "## Findings\|## Issues\|## Changes Required" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; } | head -50 | _md5)
231	  fi
232	  jq -nc --arg f "$rel" --argjson v "$vj" --argjson p "$pj" --arg h "$hash" '
233	    def sid: if type == "string" and test("^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$") then . else null end;
234	    def tsv: if type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$") then . else null end;
235	    {file: $f, exists: true, trailer: ($v.trailer_found == true),
236	     verdict: ($v.verdict | if type == "string" then . else null end),
237	     counts: ($v.counts // null), exit_code: ($v.exit_code // 1),
238	     sprint_id: ($p.sprint_id | sid), ts: ($p.ts | tsv), hash: $h}
239	    | .approved = (.exit_code == 0 and .verdict == "APPROVED")'
240	}

242	# impl_commit SINCE → "sha epoch" of the newest non-merge commit on HEAD since
243	# SINCE touching a path outside the state/generated set, or nothing
244	impl_commit() {
245	  git -C "$root" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
246	  git -C "$root" log --no-merges -n 1 --format='%H %ct' ${1:+"--since=$1"} -- . \
247	    ':(exclude,glob)grimoires/**' ':(exclude,glob).run/**' ':(exclude,glob)**/REPO-MAP.md' \
248	    ':(exclude,glob)**/checksums.json' ':(exclude,glob)**/CHANGELOG.md' 2>/dev/null || true

251	# The ordered rounds of one sprint directory: every -rN file, then the current
252	# file unless it is byte-identical to the highest -rN of its gate
253	rounds_of() {
254	  local dir="$1" g base f n top topn cur
255	  for g in review audit; do
256	    if [[ "$g" == review ]]; then base=engineer-feedback; else base=auditor-sprint-feedback; fi
257	    top=""; topn=-1
258	    for f in "$dir/$base"-r*.md; do
259	      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
260	      n=${f##*-r}; n=${n%.md}
261	      [[ "$n" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}$ ]] || continue
262	      fb_parse "$f" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" --argjson n "$((10#$n))" '. + {gate: $g, round: $n}'
263	      if (( 10#$n > topn )); then topn=$((10#$n)); top="$f"; fi
264	    done
265	    cur="$dir/$base.md"
266	    if [[ -f "$cur" ]] && ! { [[ -n "$top" ]] && cmp -s "$cur" "$top"; }; then
267	      fb_parse "$cur" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" '. + {gate: $g, round: 999999}'
268	    fi
269	  done
270	}

272	# Shared jq definitions: time, the breaker recompute and the run-state resolution
273	JQ_DEFS='
274	def epoch: if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) else null end;
275	def fresh($now; $win): epoch as $t | $t != null and ($now - $t) <= $win and ($t - $now) <= 300;
276	def recompute($rounds; $reset):
277	  ($rounds
278	   | map(select($reset == null or ((.ts // "") > $reset)))
279	   | sort_by([(.ts // ""), .round, (if .gate == "review" then 0 else 1 end)])
280	   | map(select(.approved | not))) as $nr
281	  | reduce $nr[] as $r ({cycle: 0, same: 0, hash: null, np: 0, lc: null};
282	      .cycle += 1
283	      | (if $r.hash != "none" and $r.hash == .hash then .same += 1 else .same = 1 | .hash = $r.hash end)
284	      | ($r.counts | tojson) as $c
285	      | (if .lc != null and .lc == $c then .np += 1 else .np = 0 end)
286	      | .lc = $c);
287	def skeleton($th; $ts):
288	  {state: "CLOSED",
289	   triggers: {same_issue: {count: 0, threshold: $th.same, last_hash: null},
290	              no_progress: {count: 0, threshold: $th.np},
291	              cycle_count: {current: 0, limit: $th.cycles},
292	              timeout: {started: $ts, limit_hours: $th.hours}},
293	   history: []};
294	def merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts):
295	  (if type == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
296	  | .triggers = (.triggers // {})
297	  | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ([(.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0), $rc.cycle] | max)
298	  | (if $rc.same > (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0)
299	     then .triggers.same_issue.count = $rc.same | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $rc.hash else . end)
300	  | (if $rc.np > (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) or (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts == null and $rc.lc != null)
301	     then .triggers.no_progress.count = ([(.triggers.no_progress.count // 0), $rc.np] | max)
302	          | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $rc.lc else . end)
303	  | ( if (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
304	        then ["same_issue", "same issue hash repeated \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times (derived from the feedback history)"]
305	      elif (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
306	        then ["no_progress", "counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
307	      elif (.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
308	        then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
309	      else null end ) as $trip
310	  | if $trip != null and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
311	    then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], source: "derive"}])
312	    else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end;
313	def known_ids: (.derivation.sprint_ids // null) // ((.sprints.list // []) | map(.id? // empty));
314	def resolve($f; $now; $win):
315	  . as $c
316	  | (if ($c | type) == "object" then $c else {} end) as $c
317	  | ($c.state // $c.status // "") as $cs
318	  | ($c | known_ids) as $known
319	  | ([$f.sprints[] | select(.state != "complete")
320	      | "sprint-\(.global_id)" as $g | .local_label as $l
321	      | select(($known | index($g)) == null and ($l == "" or ($known | index($l)) == null))] | length > 0) as $new
322	  | ((($c.completion // {}) | .merged_sha? // "") | type == "string" and length > 0) as $merged
323	  | if ($c.state // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or ($c.status // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or $merged then "JACKED_OUT"
324	    elif $f.breaker_open or $cs == "HALTED" then "HALTED"
325	    elif $f.all_complete then "COMPLETE"
326	    elif $cs == "COMPLETE" and ($new | not) then "COMPLETE"
327	    elif ($c.timestamps.last_activity? // null) | fresh($now; $win) then "RUNNING"
328	    else "INTERRUPTED" end;
329	'

331	cmd_derive() {
332	  local ledger="$root/grimoires/loa/ledger.json" a2a="$root/grimoires/loa/a2a" active rows
333	  if [[ ! -f "$ledger" ]] || ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$ledger" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
334	    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: no readable ledger at $ledger — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4
335	  fi
336	  active=$(jq -r '.active_cycle // empty | strings' "$ledger")
337	  if [[ -z "$active" ]] || ! jq -e --arg c "$active" 'any(.cycles[]?; .id == $c)' "$ledger" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
338	    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: the ledger has no active cycle — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4
339	  fi
340	  local win now now_ts fa=1 th
341	  win=$(( $(cfg_int '.run_mode.stale_hours' 12 8760) * 3600 ))
342	  [[ "$(cfg '.run_mode.file_authoritative')" == false ]] && fa=0
343	  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
344	              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
345	              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
346	              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
347	              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
348	  now=$(date +%s); now_ts=$(now_iso)
349	
350	  # Per-sprint facts
351	  local sprints="[]" gid label lstatus since dir rv au mex msid ic sj
352	  rows=$(jq -r --arg c "$active" '
353	    (.cycles[] | select(.id == $c)) as $cy
354	    | ($cy.sprints // [])[]
355	    | select((.global_id | type) == "number")
356	    | [(.global_id | tostring), ((.local_label // "") | tostring), ((.status // "") | tostring),
357	       ([.started, .created, $cy.created] | map(select(type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-")))
358	        | if length == 0 then "" else ([.[0], ($cy.created // "")] | max) end)]
359	    | map(if . == "" then "-" else . end)
360	    | @tsv' "$ledger")
361	  # "-" stands for an empty field: IFS whitespace (tab) would collapse two adjacent separators
362	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r gid label lstatus since; do
363	    [[ "$gid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
364	    [[ "$label" == - ]] && label=""
365	    [[ "$since" == - ]] && since=""
366	    [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ ]] || label=""
367	    [[ "$lstatus" =~ ^[a-z_]{1,32}$ ]] || lstatus="unknown"
368	    [[ "$since" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$ ]] || since=""
369	    dir="$a2a/sprint-$gid"
370	    rv=$(fb_parse "$dir/engineer-feedback.md" review)
371	    au=$(fb_parse "$dir/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" audit)
372	    mex=false; msid=""
373	    if [[ -f "$dir/COMPLETED" ]]; then
374	      mex=true
375	      msid=$(sed -n 's/^sprint:[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9._-]*\).*/\1/p' "$dir/COMPLETED" | head -n 1) || msid=""
376	    fi
377	    ic=$(impl_commit "$since")
378	    sj=$(jq -nc --argjson gid "$gid" --arg label "$label" --arg status "$lstatus" --argjson rv "$rv" --argjson au "$au" \
379	              --argjson mex "$mex" --arg msid "$msid" --arg ic "$ic" '
380	      def mine: type == "string" and length > 0 and (. == "sprint-\($gid)" or ($label != "" and . == $label));
381	      ($rv.approved == true and ($rv.sprint_id | mine)) as $R
382	      | ($au.approved == true and ($au.sprint_id | mine)) as $A
383	      | ([$rv.sprint_id, $au.sprint_id, (if $msid == "" then null else $msid end)] | map(select(type == "string" and length > 0))) as $ids
384	      | ($mex and any($ids[]; mine | not)) as $stale
385	      | ($mex and ($stale | not) and (($rv.sprint_id | mine) or ($au.sprint_id | mine))) as $M
386	      | ($ic | split(" ")) as $c
387	      | ([$rv.ts, $au.ts] | map(select(. != null)) | max) as $vts
388	      | def verdict($x): if $x.exists then {verdict: $x.verdict, sprint_id: $x.sprint_id, consistent: ($x.exit_code == 0), file: $x.file} else null end;
389	      {global_id: $gid, local_label: $label, status: $status,
390	       completed_marker: $M, marker_present: $mex, stale_marker: $stale,
391	       review: verdict($rv), audit: verdict($au),
392	       impl_commit: (if ($c | length) == 2 then $c[0] else null end),
393	       commit_after_verdict: (if ($c | length) == 2 and $vts != null
394	                              then (($c[1] | tonumber) > ($vts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch 0)) else null end),
395	       legacy_feedback: ([$rv, $au] | map(select(.exists and (.trailer | not)) | .file)),
396	       state: (if $M and $R and $A and $status == "completed" then "complete"
397	               elif ($M | not) and $R and $A then "awaiting_marker" else "in_progress" end)}')
398	    sprints=$(jq -c --argjson s "$sj" '. + [$s]' <<<"$sprints")
399	  done <<<"$rows"
400	
401	  # Breaker recompute over the active sprint's ordered rounds
402	  local active_gid rounds cache="null" cache_ok=1 bcache="null" reset rc merged
403	  active_gid=$(jq -r 'if length == 0 then "" else ((map(select(.state != "complete")) | .[0]) // .[-1]) | .global_id | tostring end' <<<"$sprints")
404	  rounds="[]"
405	  if [[ -n "$active_gid" && -d "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" ]]; then
406	    rounds=$(rounds_of "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" | jq -sc '.')
407	  fi
408	  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
409	    if cache=$(jq -c . "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [[ -n "$cache" ]]; then :; else cache="null"; cache_ok=0; fi
410	  fi
411	  if [[ -f "$breaker" ]]; then bcache=$(jq -c 'if type == "object" then . else null end' "$breaker" 2>/dev/null) || bcache="null"; [[ -n "$bcache" ]] || bcache="null"; fi
412	  reset=$(jq -c '.reset_at? // null | if type == "string" then . else null end' <<<"$bcache")
413	  rc=$(jq -nc --argjson r "$rounds" --argjson z "$reset" "$JQ_DEFS"' recompute($r; $z)')
414	  merged=$(jq -c --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' <<<"$bcache")
415	
416	  local facts report
417	  facts=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$sprints" --argjson b "$merged" '
418	    {sprints: $s,
419	     all_complete: (($s | length) > 0 and all($s[]; .state == "complete")),
420	     breaker_open: ($b.state == "OPEN"),
421	     stale_markers: [$s[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id)"],
422	     legacy_feedback: [$s[] | .legacy_feedback[]],
423	     sprint_ids: [$s[] | "sprint-\(.global_id)"]}')
424	  report=$(jq -nc --argjson f "$facts" --argjson c "$cache" --argjson b "$merged" --argjson rc "$rc" \
425	                  --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" --arg cycle "$active" \
426	                  --argjson fa "$fa" --argjson cache_ok "$cache_ok" --arg ag "$active_gid" "$JQ_DEFS"'
427	    def st: if type == "string" then (if test("^[A-Z_]{1,32}$") then . else "INVALID" end) else null end;
428	    ($c | resolve($f; $now; $win)) as $s
429	    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.state | st) else null end) as $cs
430	    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.status | st) else null end) as $cst
431	    | {cycle: $cycle, derived_at: $ts, stale_hours: ($win / 3600), file_authoritative: ($fa == 1),
432	       state: $s, cache_state: $cs, cache_status: $cst,
433	       cache: (if $cache_ok == 0 then "unparseable" elif $c == null then "missing" else "present" end),
434	       drift: ($c != null and ($cs != $s or ($cst != null and $cst != $s))),
435	       notes: ([
436	         (if $cs != null and $cst != null and $cs != $cst then "cache .state \($cs) and .status \($cst) disagree" else empty end),
437	         (if $s == "JACKED_OUT" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "JACKED_OUT is terminal: files show incomplete sprints; the cache is kept" else empty end),
438	         (if $s == "COMPLETE" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "COMPLETE kept: no new incomplete sprint in the ledger" else empty end),
439	         ($f.sprints[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id): COMPLETED marker names another sprint (stale_marker, not counted)"),
440	         ($f.sprints[] | select(.state == "awaiting_marker") | "sprint-\(.global_id): review and audit APPROVED, no COMPLETED marker")
441	       ]),
442	       sprints: $f.sprints,
443	       active_sprint: (if $ag == "" then null else "sprint-\($ag)" end),
444	       breaker: {state: $b.state, cycle_count: $b.triggers.cycle_count.current, same_issue: $b.triggers.same_issue.count,
445	                 no_progress: $b.triggers.no_progress.count, recomputed: {cycle_count: $rc.cycle, same_issue: $rc.same, no_progress: $rc.np}},
446	       derivation: {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback},
447	       written: false}')
448	
449	  if (( write )); then
450	    local why=""
451	    if (( fa == 0 )); then why="run_mode.file_authoritative: false — report-only"
452	    elif [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then why="no run state at $file — nothing to rewrite"
453	    elif (( cache_ok == 0 )); then why="$file unparseable — kept for inspection, not rewritten"
454	    fi
455	    if [[ -z "$why" ]]; then
456	      atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' || return 3
457	      merged=$(jq -c . "$breaker")
458	      facts=$(jq -c --argjson b "$merged" '.breaker_open = ($b.state == "OPEN")' <<<"$facts")
459	      atomic_update "$file" --argjson f "$facts" --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"'
460	        resolve($f; $now; $win) as $s
461	        | .state = $s | .status = $s | .derived_at = $ts
462	        | .derivation = {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback, sprint_ids: $f.sprint_ids}
463	        | .schema_version = (.schema_version // 2)' || return 3
464	      report=$(jq -c --slurpfile c "$file" --argjson b "$merged" '.written = true | .state = $c[0].state | .breaker.state = $b.state' <<<"$report")
465	    else
466	      report=$(jq -c --arg w "$why" '.notes += [$w]' <<<"$report")
467	    fi
468	  fi
469	
470	  if (( json )); then
471	    jq . <<<"$report"
472	  else
473	    jq -r '"derive: files say \(.state), cache said \(.cache_state // "nothing") (\(if .drift then "drift" else "in sync" end))"
474	           + (if .written then " — caches rewritten" else "" end), (.notes[] | "  note: " + .)' <<<"$report"
475	  fi
476	  return 0
477	}

479	cmd_record_round() {
480	  [[ -n "$gate" && -n "$file" ]] || usage
481	  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: record-round: no feedback file at $file" >&2; return 2; fi
482	  local p th ts now out trip
483	  p=$(fb_parse "$file" "$gate")
484	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.approved' <<<"$p")" == true ]]; then
485	    echo "recorded: $gate APPROVED — breaker counters unchanged"
486	    return 0
487	  fi
488	  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
489	              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
490	              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
491	              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
492	              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
493	  ts=$(now_iso); now=$(date +%s)
494	  atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson p "$p" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$ts" --argjson now "$now" \
495	      --arg gate "$gate" --arg sprint "$sprint" "$JQ_DEFS"'
496	    (if type == "object" and (.triggers | type) == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
497	    | ($p.counts | tojson) as $c
498	    | (if $p.hash != "none" and $p.hash == (.triggers.same_issue.last_hash // null)
499	       then .triggers.same_issue.count = ((.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) + 1)
500	       else .triggers.same_issue.count = 1 | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $p.hash end)
501	    | (if (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts // null) != null and .triggers.no_progress.last_counts == $c
502	       then .triggers.no_progress.count = ((.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) + 1)
503	       else .triggers.no_progress.count = 0 end)
504	    | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $c
505	    | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ((.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) + 1)
506	    | (.triggers.timeout.started // null | epoch) as $start
507	    | ( if .triggers.same_issue.count >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
508	          then ["same_issue", "same issue hash \($p.hash[0:8]) seen \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times in a row"]
509	        elif .triggers.no_progress.count >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
510	          then ["no_progress", "finding counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds"]
511	        elif .triggers.cycle_count.current >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
512	          then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds reached the limit \(.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)"]
513	        elif $start != null and ($now - $start) >= ((.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) * 3600)
514	          then ["timeout", "run older than \(.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) hours"]
515	        elif (.state // "CLOSED") == "OPEN" then ["open", "breaker already OPEN"]
516	        else null end ) as $trip
517	    | .last_round = {gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end), verdict: $p.verdict, hash: $p.hash, ts: $ts}
518	    | if $trip != null and $trip[0] != "open" and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
519	      then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end)}])
520	      elif $trip != null then .state = "OPEN"
521	      else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end
522	    | .last_trip = $trip' || return 3
523	  trip=$(jq -r '.last_trip // empty | if type == "array" then "\(.[0]): \(.[1])" else empty end' "$breaker")
524	  out=$(jq -r '"recorded: \(.last_round.gate) \(.last_round.verdict // "no verdict") — cycle \(.triggers.cycle_count.current)/\(.triggers.cycle_count.limit), same_issue \(.triggers.same_issue.count)/\(.triggers.same_issue.threshold), no_progress \(.triggers.no_progress.count)/\(.triggers.no_progress.threshold)"' "$breaker")
525	  echo "$out"
526	  if [[ -n "$trip" ]]; then
527	    atomic_update "$state_file" --arg ts "$ts" '.state = "HALTED"' || return 3
528	    echo "TRIPPED: $trip"
529	    return 10
530	  fi
531	  return 0
532	}
533	
534	cmd_mark() {
535	  [[ -n "$skill" && -n "$sprint" ]] || usage
536	  mkdir -p "$run_dir"
537	  atomic_update "$run_dir/implement-active.json" --arg k "$skill" --arg s "$sprint" --arg ts "$(now_iso)" \
538	    '{skill: $k, sprint: $s, started_at: $ts}' || return 3
539	  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
540	    local err drc=0
541	    err=$( { write=1; json=0; cmd_derive >/dev/null; } 2>&1 ) || drc=$?
542	    if (( drc != 0 && drc != 4 )); then printf '%s\n' "$err" >&2; fi
543	  fi
544	  echo "marked: $skill $sprint ($run_dir/implement-active.json)"
545	}
546	
547	case "$sub" in
548	  write)  cmd_write ;;
549	  read)   cmd_read ;;

551	  record-round) cmd_record_round ;;

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-checkpoint.sh — run position in .run/ (cycle-125 FR-3, SDD D-3.2;
# cycle-129 FR-4(f)/FR-5, SDD D-4.6, D-5.1 … D-5.4). Beads are the task ledger;
# the checkpoint is a HINT; the run state and the breaker are caches DERIVED
# from files (COMPLETED markers, LOA-VERDICT trailers, the ledger, git).
#
#   run-checkpoint.sh write --sprint sprint-N --phase PHASE [--task BEAD-ID] [--file F]
#       Atomically sets .schema_version = 2, .checkpoint = {sprint, task, phase, ts}
#       and .timestamps.last_activity = ts: jq → F.tmp.$$ → mv -f, under flock
#       on F.lock. F must already exist (a run in progress). Then runs
#       `derive --write` (a missing ledger is skipped). Exit 0 · 2 usage /
#       no run · 3 write failed (the previous file is untouched).
#   run-checkpoint.sh read [--file F] [--json]
#       Prints the checkpoint when it is trustworthy: parses, and when a task
#       is named, `br show <task> --json` reports it closed (a checkpoint that
#       names an open or unknown bead is DISCARDED with a logged line — beads
#       remain the recovery source). schema_version 1 / no checkpoint → prints
#       "sprint granularity". Exit 0 always when F exists; 2 when it does not.
#   run-checkpoint.sh derive [--json] [--write] [--root DIR] [--file F]
#       For the ledger's active cycle, per sprint: global_id, local_label,
#       ledger status, completed_marker (a2a/sprint-<gid>/COMPLETED exists and
#       the feedback trailers name this sprint, as sprint-<gid> or the local
#       label; a trailer or a `sprint:` line naming another sprint makes it a
#       stale_marker, treated as absent), review/audit verdicts (verdict-derive.sh;
#       APPROVED needs exit 0; a file without a trailer is legacy: no verdict,
#       listed in derivation.legacy_feedback), impl_commit (newest non-merge
#       commit on HEAD since max(sprint started|created, cycle created) touching
#       a path outside grimoires/, .run/, REPO-MAP.md, checksums.json,
#       CHANGELOG.md) and state complete | awaiting_marker | in_progress.
#       Run state, first match wins:
#         cache .state or .status JACKED_OUT, or .completion.merged_sha → JACKED_OUT (terminal)
#         breaker OPEN, or cache HALTED                                 → HALTED (sticky until /run-resume)
#         every sprint complete                                         → COMPLETE
#         cache COMPLETE and the ledger registers no new incomplete sprint → COMPLETE
#         last_activity within run_mode.stale_hours (12)                → RUNNING
#         otherwise                                                     → INTERRUPTED
#       Breaker (active sprint = first incomplete, else the last): the ordered
#       rounds engineer-feedback-r*.md, auditor-sprint-feedback-r*.md and the
#       current files (sorted by trailer ts, round, gate; rounds before the
#       breaker's reset_at are ignored) give cycle_count (non-APPROVED rounds),
#       same_issue (consecutive equal hashes) and no_progress (consecutive
#       equal counts); each cached counter is raised to its recomputed value,
#       never lowered; OPEN when a count threshold is met (timeout is left to
#       record-round). --json prints the derivation; --write rewrites F
#       (.state canonical, .status mirrored, derived_at, derivation {source,
#       stale_markers, legacy_feedback, sprint_ids}; schema_version kept) and
#       the breaker, under their locks — only when F exists, parses, and
#       run_mode.file_authoritative is not false (false = report-only).
#       Exit 0 · 4 no ledger / no active cycle · 2 usage.
#   run-checkpoint.sh record-round --gate review|audit --file FEEDBACK [--sprint sprint-N]
#                                  [--state-file F] [--breaker B]
#       After a review or audit: verdict-derive.sh --json on FEEDBACK; the
#       same-issue hash is md5 of `jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}'` of that output
#       (no trailer: md5 of the first 50 lines from ## Findings / ## Issues /
#       ## Changes Required). APPROVED (exit 0) leaves every counter as is.
#       Otherwise, atomically on B: same_issue +1 when the hash equals
#       last_hash, else count 1 and last_hash = hash; no_progress +1 when the
#       counts equal the previous round's, else 0; cycle_count.current +1; then
#       the triggers in order same_issue ≥ threshold, no_progress ≥ threshold,
#       cycle_count ≥ limit, timeout (now - started ≥ limit_hours). A trip sets
#       state OPEN, appends history {timestamp, trigger, reason, gate, sprint},
#       sets F (.run/state.json) .state = HALTED, prints
#       `TRIPPED: <trigger>: <reason>` and exits 10 (also when B is already OPEN).
#       Exit 0 recorded · 2 usage / missing file · 3 write failed · 10 tripped.
#   run-checkpoint.sh mark --skill implement|bug --sprint ID [--root DIR]
#       Writes .run/implement-active.json {skill, sprint, started_at} (the
#       implement gate's marker sanction, valid two hours), then runs
#       `derive --write` when F exists. `unmark` removes the marker. Exit 0 · 2 usage.
#
# Default F: $LOA_RUN_DIR/sprint-plan-state.json, else <root>/.run/sprint-plan-state.json
# (--root DIR sets <root> and ignores LOA_RUN_DIR). B: <run dir>/circuit-breaker.json.
# Readers accept schema_version 1 and 2 and files without derived_at/derivation.
# Config (<root>/.loa.config.yaml, yq; absent = defaults): run_mode.stale_hours (12),
# run_mode.file_authoritative (true), run_mode.circuit_breaker.{same_issue,no_progress}_threshold
# (3, 5), run_mode.defaults.{max_cycles,timeout_hours} (20, 8) for a new breaker file.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
VERDICT_DERIVE="$SCRIPT_DIR/verdict-derive.sh"
usage() { sed -n '3,/^# Default F/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }

sub="${1:-}"; [[ -n "$sub" ]] || usage; shift
file="" sprint="" task="" phase="" json=0 write=0 root="" gate="" state_file="" breaker="" skill=""
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --file)   [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || usage; file="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --sprint) [[ $# -ge 2 && "$2" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]] || usage; sprint="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --task)   [[ $# -ge 2 && "$2" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]] || usage; task="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --phase)  [[ $# -ge 2 && "$2" =~ ^[A-Z_]+$ ]] || usage; phase="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --json)   json=1; shift ;;
    --write)  write=1; shift ;;
    --root)   [[ $# -ge 2 && -d "${2:-}" ]] || usage; root="$(cd "$2" && pwd)"; shift 2 ;;
    --gate)   [[ $# -ge 2 && ( "$2" == review || "$2" == audit ) ]] || usage; gate="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --state-file|--file-state) [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || usage; state_file="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --breaker) [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || usage; breaker="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --skill)  [[ $# -ge 2 && ( "$2" == implement || "$2" == bug ) ]] || usage; skill="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    *) usage ;;
  esac
done

# Root and run dir: --root wins (and pins the run dir under it); else the
# directory holding a --file that sits in a .run/ dir (write/read/derive only);
# else this script's checkout with $LOA_RUN_DIR honoured.
if [[ -n "$root" ]]; then
  run_dir="$root/.run"
else
  root="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  run_dir="${LOA_RUN_DIR:-$root/.run}"
  if [[ -n "$file" && "$sub" != record-round ]]; then
    fdir="$(cd "$(dirname "$file")" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || fdir=""
    if [[ -n "$fdir" && "$(basename "$fdir")" == .run ]]; then root="$(dirname "$fdir")"; run_dir="$fdir"; fi
  fi
fi
if [[ "$sub" != record-round && -z "$file" ]]; then file="$run_dir/sprint-plan-state.json"; fi
[[ -n "$breaker" ]] || breaker="$run_dir/circuit-breaker.json"
[[ -n "$state_file" ]] || state_file="$run_dir/state.json"
CONFIG="$root/.loa.config.yaml"

now_iso() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }

# cfg KEY → the raw yq value ("null" when absent or unreadable). yq's `//`
# treats false as absent, so callers compare the raw text.
cfg() {
  local v
  if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ -f "$CONFIG" ]]; then
    v=$(yq "$1" "$CONFIG" 2>/dev/null) || v="null"
    printf '%s' "${v//\"/}"
  else
    printf 'null'
  fi
}
cfg_int() {  # KEY DEFAULT MAX → a positive integer ≤ MAX, else DEFAULT
  local v; v=$(cfg "$1")
  if [[ "$v" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( v > 0 && v <= $3 )); then printf '%s' "$v"; else printf '%s' "$2"; fi
}

_md5() { if command -v md5sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1; else md5 -q; fi; }

# atomic_update FILE JQ-ARGS... — jq over FILE (or {} when FILE is absent) →
# FILE.tmp.$$ → mv -f, under flock on FILE.lock. Exit 3 on any failure; the
# previous file is untouched.
atomic_update() {
  local f="$1"; shift
  local tmp="$f.tmp.$$" rc=0
  (
    # flock is util-linux (Linux); without it (macOS) the write is still atomic
    # (tmp + mv) but concurrent writers may interleave — last writer wins.
    if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then flock -w 5 9 || { echo "run-checkpoint: lock timeout on $f.lock" >&2; exit 3; }; fi
    if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then
      jq "$@" "$f" > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: $f is not valid JSON — not written" >&2; exit 3; }
    else
      jq "$@" <<<'{}' > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: could not build $f" >&2; exit 3; }
    fi
    jq -e . "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: refusing to replace $f with unparseable output" >&2; exit 3; }
    mv -f -- "$tmp" "$f"
  ) 9>"$f.lock" || rc=$?
  return $rc
}

cmd_write() {
  [[ -n "$sprint" && -n "$phase" ]] || usage
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: no run state at $file (start a run first)" >&2; return 2; fi
  local ts rc=0
  ts=$(now_iso)
  atomic_update "$file" --arg s "$sprint" --arg t "$task" --arg p "$phase" --arg ts "$ts" \
    '.schema_version = 2
     | .checkpoint = {sprint: $s, task: (if $t == "" then null else $t end), phase: $p, ts: $ts}
     | .timestamps = ((.timestamps // {}) + {last_activity: $ts})' || rc=$?
  (( rc == 0 )) || return $rc
  # Every checkpoint refreshes the derived caches (D-5.2); a missing ledger (4) is not an error here
  local err drc=0
  err=$( { write=1; json=0; cmd_derive >/dev/null; } 2>&1 ) || drc=$?
  if (( drc != 0 && drc != 4 )); then printf '%s\n' "$err" >&2; fi
  return 0
}

bead_closed() {  # $1 bead id → 0 when br reports closed
  command -v br >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 2
  local js st
  js=$(br show "$1" --json 2>/dev/null) || return 1
  st=$(printf '%s' "$js" | jq -r 'if type=="array" then .[0] else . end | .status // .issue.status // empty' 2>/dev/null) || return 1
  [[ "$st" == "closed" ]]
}

cmd_read() {
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: no run state at $file" >&2; return 2; fi
  if ! jq -e . "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "run-checkpoint: $file unparseable — no checkpoint; beads are the recovery truth" >&2; if (( json )); then echo '{"checkpoint":null,"reason":"unparseable"}'; fi; return 0; fi
  local sv cp s t p ts reason="" brc
  sv=$(jq -r '.schema_version // 1' "$file"); cp=$(jq -c '.checkpoint // null' "$file")
  [[ "$sv" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || sv=1
  if [[ "$cp" == "null" || "$sv" -lt 2 ]]; then
    if (( json )); then echo '{"checkpoint":null,"reason":"sprint granularity"}'; else echo "checkpoint: none (schema_version $sv → sprint granularity; resume at the first open bead of sprints.current)"; fi
    return 0
  fi
  s=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.sprint // empty' "$file"); t=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.task // empty' "$file"); p=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.phase // empty' "$file"); ts=$(jq -r '.checkpoint.ts // empty' "$file")
  if [[ -z "$s" || -z "$p" ]]; then reason="malformed checkpoint"
  elif [[ -n "$t" ]]; then
    # A task checkpoint is trusted only when beads CONFIRMS the task closed;
    # "br unavailable" is not a confirmation (Bridgebuilder PR #1269 FIND-003).
    brc=0; bead_closed "$t" || brc=$?
    case $brc in 0) ;; 2) reason="beads unavailable — task $t cannot be verified";; *) reason="task $t is not closed in beads";; esac
  fi
  if [[ -n "$reason" ]]; then
    echo "run-checkpoint: discarding checkpoint ($reason) — resume from the first open bead of $s" >&2
    if (( json )); then jq -cn --arg r "$reason" --arg s "$s" '{checkpoint:null, reason:$r, sprint:$s}'; else echo "checkpoint: discarded ($reason); resume at the first open bead of $s"; fi
    return 0
  fi
  if (( json )); then jq -c '{checkpoint: .checkpoint}' "$file"
  else echo "checkpoint: $s ${t:+task $t }phase $p at $ts → resume at the first open bead after $t in $s"; fi
}

# fb_parse FILE GATE → one compact JSON object: {file, exists, trailer, verdict,
# counts, exit_code, sprint_id, ts, approved, hash}. The hash is the run-mode
# same-issue hash (md5 of `jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}'` over verdict-derive's
# --json output; legacy files hash their findings section).
fb_parse() {
  local f="$1" g="$2" rel vj tl pj hash
  rel="${f#"$root"/}"
  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then jq -nc --arg f "$rel" '{file: $f, exists: false}'; return 0; fi
  vj=$(bash "$VERDICT_DERIVE" --file "$f" --gate "$g" --json 2>/dev/null) || true
  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$vj" || vj='{"trailer_found":false,"verdict":null,"counts":null,"exit_code":1}'
  tl=$(grep -E '^<!-- LOA-VERDICT \{.*\} -->[[:space:]]*$' "$f" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1) || tl=""
  pj=$(printf '%s' "$tl" | sed -E 's/^<!-- LOA-VERDICT (.*) -->[[:space:]]*$/\1/')
  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$pj" || pj='{}'
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.trailer_found' <<<"$vj")" == true ]]; then
    hash=$(printf '%s\n' "$vj" | jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}' | _md5)
  else
    hash=$( { grep -A 100 "## Findings\|## Issues\|## Changes Required" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; } | head -50 | _md5)
  fi
  jq -nc --arg f "$rel" --argjson v "$vj" --argjson p "$pj" --arg h "$hash" '
    def sid: if type == "string" and test("^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$") then . else null end;
    def tsv: if type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$") then . else null end;
    {file: $f, exists: true, trailer: ($v.trailer_found == true),
     verdict: ($v.verdict | if type == "string" then . else null end),
     counts: ($v.counts // null), exit_code: ($v.exit_code // 1),
     sprint_id: ($p.sprint_id | sid), ts: ($p.ts | tsv), hash: $h}
    | .approved = (.exit_code == 0 and .verdict == "APPROVED")'
}

# impl_commit SINCE → "sha epoch" of the newest non-merge commit on HEAD since
# SINCE touching a path outside the state/generated set, or nothing
impl_commit() {
  git -C "$root" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
  git -C "$root" log --no-merges -n 1 --format='%H %ct' ${1:+"--since=$1"} -- . \
    ':(exclude,glob)grimoires/**' ':(exclude,glob).run/**' ':(exclude,glob)**/REPO-MAP.md' \
    ':(exclude,glob)**/checksums.json' ':(exclude,glob)**/CHANGELOG.md' 2>/dev/null || true
}

# The ordered rounds of one sprint directory: every -rN file, then the current
# file unless it is byte-identical to the highest -rN of its gate
rounds_of() {
  local dir="$1" g base f n top topn cur
  for g in review audit; do
    if [[ "$g" == review ]]; then base=engineer-feedback; else base=auditor-sprint-feedback; fi
    top=""; topn=-1
    for f in "$dir/$base"-r*.md; do
      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
      n=${f##*-r}; n=${n%.md}
      [[ "$n" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}$ ]] || continue
      fb_parse "$f" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" --argjson n "$((10#$n))" '. + {gate: $g, round: $n}'
      if (( 10#$n > topn )); then topn=$((10#$n)); top="$f"; fi
    done
    cur="$dir/$base.md"
    if [[ -f "$cur" ]] && ! { [[ -n "$top" ]] && cmp -s "$cur" "$top"; }; then
      fb_parse "$cur" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" '. + {gate: $g, round: 999999}'
    fi
  done
}

# Shared jq definitions: time, the breaker recompute and the run-state resolution
JQ_DEFS='
def epoch: if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) else null end;
def fresh($now; $win): epoch as $t | $t != null and ($now - $t) <= $win and ($t - $now) <= 300;
def recompute($rounds; $reset):
  ($rounds
   | map(select($reset == null or ((.ts // "") > $reset)))
   | sort_by([(.ts // ""), .round, (if .gate == "review" then 0 else 1 end)])
   | map(select(.approved | not))) as $nr
  | reduce $nr[] as $r ({cycle: 0, same: 0, hash: null, np: 0, lc: null};
      .cycle += 1
      | (if $r.hash != "none" and $r.hash == .hash then .same += 1 else .same = 1 | .hash = $r.hash end)
      | ($r.counts | tojson) as $c
      | (if .lc != null and .lc == $c then .np += 1 else .np = 0 end)
      | .lc = $c);
def skeleton($th; $ts):
  {state: "CLOSED",
   triggers: {same_issue: {count: 0, threshold: $th.same, last_hash: null},
              no_progress: {count: 0, threshold: $th.np},
              cycle_count: {current: 0, limit: $th.cycles},
              timeout: {started: $ts, limit_hours: $th.hours}},
   history: []};
def merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts):
  (if type == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
  | .triggers = (.triggers // {})
  | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ([(.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0), $rc.cycle] | max)
  | (if $rc.same > (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0)
     then .triggers.same_issue.count = $rc.same | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $rc.hash else . end)
  | (if $rc.np > (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) or (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts == null and $rc.lc != null)
     then .triggers.no_progress.count = ([(.triggers.no_progress.count // 0), $rc.np] | max)
          | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $rc.lc else . end)
  | ( if (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
        then ["same_issue", "same issue hash repeated \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times (derived from the feedback history)"]
      elif (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
        then ["no_progress", "counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
      elif (.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
        then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
      else null end ) as $trip
  | if $trip != null and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
    then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], source: "derive"}])
    else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end;
def known_ids: (.derivation.sprint_ids // null) // ((.sprints.list // []) | map(.id? // empty));
def resolve($f; $now; $win):
  . as $c
  | (if ($c | type) == "object" then $c else {} end) as $c
  | ($c.state // $c.status // "") as $cs
  | ($c | known_ids) as $known
  | ([$f.sprints[] | select(.state != "complete")
      | "sprint-\(.global_id)" as $g | .local_label as $l
      | select(($known | index($g)) == null and ($l == "" or ($known | index($l)) == null))] | length > 0) as $new
  | ((($c.completion // {}) | .merged_sha? // "") | type == "string" and length > 0) as $merged
  | if ($c.state // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or ($c.status // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or $merged then "JACKED_OUT"
    elif $f.breaker_open or $cs == "HALTED" then "HALTED"
    elif $f.all_complete then "COMPLETE"
    elif $cs == "COMPLETE" and ($new | not) then "COMPLETE"
    elif ($c.timestamps.last_activity? // null) | fresh($now; $win) then "RUNNING"
    else "INTERRUPTED" end;
'

cmd_derive() {
  local ledger="$root/grimoires/loa/ledger.json" a2a="$root/grimoires/loa/a2a" active rows
  if [[ ! -f "$ledger" ]] || ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$ledger" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: no readable ledger at $ledger — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4
  fi
  active=$(jq -r '.active_cycle // empty | strings' "$ledger")
  if [[ -z "$active" ]] || ! jq -e --arg c "$active" 'any(.cycles[]?; .id == $c)' "$ledger" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: the ledger has no active cycle — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4
  fi
  local win now now_ts fa=1 th
  win=$(( $(cfg_int '.run_mode.stale_hours' 12 8760) * 3600 ))
  [[ "$(cfg '.run_mode.file_authoritative')" == false ]] && fa=0
  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
  now=$(date +%s); now_ts=$(now_iso)

  # Per-sprint facts
  local sprints="[]" gid label lstatus since dir rv au mex msid ic sj
  rows=$(jq -r --arg c "$active" '
    (.cycles[] | select(.id == $c)) as $cy
    | ($cy.sprints // [])[]
    | select((.global_id | type) == "number")
    | [(.global_id | tostring), ((.local_label // "") | tostring), ((.status // "") | tostring),
       ([.started, .created, $cy.created] | map(select(type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-")))
        | if length == 0 then "" else ([.[0], ($cy.created // "")] | max) end)]
    | map(if . == "" then "-" else . end)
    | @tsv' "$ledger")
  # "-" stands for an empty field: IFS whitespace (tab) would collapse two adjacent separators
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r gid label lstatus since; do
    [[ "$gid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
    [[ "$label" == - ]] && label=""
    [[ "$since" == - ]] && since=""
    [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ ]] || label=""
    [[ "$lstatus" =~ ^[a-z_]{1,32}$ ]] || lstatus="unknown"
    [[ "$since" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$ ]] || since=""
    dir="$a2a/sprint-$gid"
    rv=$(fb_parse "$dir/engineer-feedback.md" review)
    au=$(fb_parse "$dir/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" audit)
    mex=false; msid=""
    if [[ -f "$dir/COMPLETED" ]]; then
      mex=true
      msid=$(sed -n 's/^sprint:[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9._-]*\).*/\1/p' "$dir/COMPLETED" | head -n 1) || msid=""
    fi
    ic=$(impl_commit "$since")
    sj=$(jq -nc --argjson gid "$gid" --arg label "$label" --arg status "$lstatus" --argjson rv "$rv" --argjson au "$au" \
              --argjson mex "$mex" --arg msid "$msid" --arg ic "$ic" '
      def mine: type == "string" and length > 0 and (. == "sprint-\($gid)" or ($label != "" and . == $label));
      ($rv.approved == true and ($rv.sprint_id | mine)) as $R
      | ($au.approved == true and ($au.sprint_id | mine)) as $A
      | ([$rv.sprint_id, $au.sprint_id, (if $msid == "" then null else $msid end)] | map(select(type == "string" and length > 0))) as $ids
      | ($mex and any($ids[]; mine | not)) as $stale
      | ($mex and ($stale | not) and (($rv.sprint_id | mine) or ($au.sprint_id | mine))) as $M
      | ($ic | split(" ")) as $c
      | ([$rv.ts, $au.ts] | map(select(. != null)) | max) as $vts
      | def verdict($x): if $x.exists then {verdict: $x.verdict, sprint_id: $x.sprint_id, consistent: ($x.exit_code == 0), file: $x.file} else null end;
      {global_id: $gid, local_label: $label, status: $status,
       completed_marker: $M, marker_present: $mex, stale_marker: $stale,
       review: verdict($rv), audit: verdict($au),
       impl_commit: (if ($c | length) == 2 then $c[0] else null end),
       commit_after_verdict: (if ($c | length) == 2 and $vts != null
                              then (($c[1] | tonumber) > ($vts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch 0)) else null end),
       legacy_feedback: ([$rv, $au] | map(select(.exists and (.trailer | not)) | .file)),
       state: (if $M and $R and $A and $status == "completed" then "complete"
               elif ($M | not) and $R and $A then "awaiting_marker" else "in_progress" end)}')
    sprints=$(jq -c --argjson s "$sj" '. + [$s]' <<<"$sprints")
  done <<<"$rows"

  # Breaker recompute over the active sprint's ordered rounds
  local active_gid rounds cache="null" cache_ok=1 bcache="null" reset rc merged
  active_gid=$(jq -r 'if length == 0 then "" else ((map(select(.state != "complete")) | .[0]) // .[-1]) | .global_id | tostring end' <<<"$sprints")
  rounds="[]"
  if [[ -n "$active_gid" && -d "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" ]]; then
    rounds=$(rounds_of "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" | jq -sc '.')
  fi
  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
    if cache=$(jq -c . "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [[ -n "$cache" ]]; then :; else cache="null"; cache_ok=0; fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "$breaker" ]]; then bcache=$(jq -c 'if type == "object" then . else null end' "$breaker" 2>/dev/null) || bcache="null"; [[ -n "$bcache" ]] || bcache="null"; fi
  reset=$(jq -c '.reset_at? // null | if type == "string" then . else null end' <<<"$bcache")
  rc=$(jq -nc --argjson r "$rounds" --argjson z "$reset" "$JQ_DEFS"' recompute($r; $z)')
  merged=$(jq -c --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' <<<"$bcache")

  local facts report
  facts=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$sprints" --argjson b "$merged" '
    {sprints: $s,
     all_complete: (($s | length) > 0 and all($s[]; .state == "complete")),
     breaker_open: ($b.state == "OPEN"),
     stale_markers: [$s[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id)"],
     legacy_feedback: [$s[] | .legacy_feedback[]],
     sprint_ids: [$s[] | "sprint-\(.global_id)"]}')
  report=$(jq -nc --argjson f "$facts" --argjson c "$cache" --argjson b "$merged" --argjson rc "$rc" \
                  --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" --arg cycle "$active" \
                  --argjson fa "$fa" --argjson cache_ok "$cache_ok" --arg ag "$active_gid" "$JQ_DEFS"'
    def st: if type == "string" then (if test("^[A-Z_]{1,32}$") then . else "INVALID" end) else null end;
    ($c | resolve($f; $now; $win)) as $s
    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.state | st) else null end) as $cs
    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.status | st) else null end) as $cst
    | {cycle: $cycle, derived_at: $ts, stale_hours: ($win / 3600), file_authoritative: ($fa == 1),
       state: $s, cache_state: $cs, cache_status: $cst,
       cache: (if $cache_ok == 0 then "unparseable" elif $c == null then "missing" else "present" end),
       drift: ($c != null and ($cs != $s or ($cst != null and $cst != $s))),
       notes: ([
         (if $cs != null and $cst != null and $cs != $cst then "cache .state \($cs) and .status \($cst) disagree" else empty end),
         (if $s == "JACKED_OUT" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "JACKED_OUT is terminal: files show incomplete sprints; the cache is kept" else empty end),
         (if $s == "COMPLETE" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "COMPLETE kept: no new incomplete sprint in the ledger" else empty end),
         ($f.sprints[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id): COMPLETED marker names another sprint (stale_marker, not counted)"),
         ($f.sprints[] | select(.state == "awaiting_marker") | "sprint-\(.global_id): review and audit APPROVED, no COMPLETED marker")
       ]),
       sprints: $f.sprints,
       active_sprint: (if $ag == "" then null else "sprint-\($ag)" end),
       breaker: {state: $b.state, cycle_count: $b.triggers.cycle_count.current, same_issue: $b.triggers.same_issue.count,
                 no_progress: $b.triggers.no_progress.count, recomputed: {cycle_count: $rc.cycle, same_issue: $rc.same, no_progress: $rc.np}},
       derivation: {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback},
       written: false}')

  if (( write )); then
    local why=""
    if (( fa == 0 )); then why="run_mode.file_authoritative: false — report-only"
    elif [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then why="no run state at $file — nothing to rewrite"
    elif (( cache_ok == 0 )); then why="$file unparseable — kept for inspection, not rewritten"
    fi
    if [[ -z "$why" ]]; then
      atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' || return 3
      merged=$(jq -c . "$breaker")
      facts=$(jq -c --argjson b "$merged" '.breaker_open = ($b.state == "OPEN")' <<<"$facts")
      atomic_update "$file" --argjson f "$facts" --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"'
        resolve($f; $now; $win) as $s
        | .state = $s | .status = $s | .derived_at = $ts
        | .derivation = {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback, sprint_ids: $f.sprint_ids}
        | .schema_version = (.schema_version // 2)' || return 3
      report=$(jq -c --slurpfile c "$file" --argjson b "$merged" '.written = true | .state = $c[0].state | .breaker.state = $b.state' <<<"$report")
    else
      report=$(jq -c --arg w "$why" '.notes += [$w]' <<<"$report")
    fi
  fi

  if (( json )); then
    jq . <<<"$report"
  else
    jq -r '"derive: files say \(.state), cache said \(.cache_state // "nothing") (\(if .drift then "drift" else "in sync" end))"
           + (if .written then " — caches rewritten" else "" end), (.notes[] | "  note: " + .)' <<<"$report"
  fi
  return 0
}

cmd_record_round() {
  [[ -n "$gate" && -n "$file" ]] || usage
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: record-round: no feedback file at $file" >&2; return 2; fi
  local p th ts now out trip
  p=$(fb_parse "$file" "$gate")
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.approved' <<<"$p")" == true ]]; then
    echo "recorded: $gate APPROVED — breaker counters unchanged"
    return 0
  fi
  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
  ts=$(now_iso); now=$(date +%s)
  atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson p "$p" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$ts" --argjson now "$now" \
      --arg gate "$gate" --arg sprint "$sprint" "$JQ_DEFS"'
    (if type == "object" and (.triggers | type) == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
    | ($p.counts | tojson) as $c
    | (if $p.hash != "none" and $p.hash == (.triggers.same_issue.last_hash // null)
       then .triggers.same_issue.count = ((.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) + 1)
       else .triggers.same_issue.count = 1 | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $p.hash end)
    | (if (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts // null) != null and .triggers.no_progress.last_counts == $c
       then .triggers.no_progress.count = ((.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) + 1)
       else .triggers.no_progress.count = 0 end)
    | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $c
    | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ((.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) + 1)
    | (.triggers.timeout.started // null | epoch) as $start
    | ( if .triggers.same_issue.count >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
          then ["same_issue", "same issue hash \($p.hash[0:8]) seen \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times in a row"]
        elif .triggers.no_progress.count >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
          then ["no_progress", "finding counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds"]
        elif .triggers.cycle_count.current >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
          then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds reached the limit \(.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)"]
        elif $start != null and ($now - $start) >= ((.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) * 3600)
          then ["timeout", "run older than \(.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) hours"]
        elif (.state // "CLOSED") == "OPEN" then ["open", "breaker already OPEN"]
        else null end ) as $trip
    | .last_round = {gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end), verdict: $p.verdict, hash: $p.hash, ts: $ts}
    | if $trip != null and $trip[0] != "open" and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
      then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end)}])
      elif $trip != null then .state = "OPEN"
      else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end
    | .last_trip = $trip' || return 3
  trip=$(jq -r '.last_trip // empty | if type == "array" then "\(.[0]): \(.[1])" else empty end' "$breaker")
  out=$(jq -r '"recorded: \(.last_round.gate) \(.last_round.verdict // "no verdict") — cycle \(.triggers.cycle_count.current)/\(.triggers.cycle_count.limit), same_issue \(.triggers.same_issue.count)/\(.triggers.same_issue.threshold), no_progress \(.triggers.no_progress.count)/\(.triggers.no_progress.threshold)"' "$breaker")
  echo "$out"
  if [[ -n "$trip" ]]; then
    atomic_update "$state_file" --arg ts "$ts" '.state = "HALTED"' || return 3
    echo "TRIPPED: $trip"
    return 10
  fi
  return 0
}

cmd_mark() {
  [[ -n "$skill" && -n "$sprint" ]] || usage
  mkdir -p "$run_dir"
  atomic_update "$run_dir/implement-active.json" --arg k "$skill" --arg s "$sprint" --arg ts "$(now_iso)" \
    '{skill: $k, sprint: $s, started_at: $ts}' || return 3
  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
    local err drc=0
    err=$( { write=1; json=0; cmd_derive >/dev/null; } 2>&1 ) || drc=$?
    if (( drc != 0 && drc != 4 )); then printf '%s\n' "$err" >&2; fi
  fi
  echo "marked: $skill $sprint ($run_dir/implement-active.json)"
}

case "$sub" in
  write)  cmd_write ;;
  read)   cmd_read ;;
  derive) cmd_derive ;;
  record-round) cmd_record_round ;;
  mark)   cmd_mark ;;
  unmark) rm -f -- "$run_dir/implement-active.json" "$run_dir/implement-active.json.lock"; echo "unmarked" ;;
  *) usage ;;
esac

  return 1

# Sanitize: drop control bytes (keep UTF-8 multibyte), flatten whitespace, cap.
_san() { printf '%s' "${1-}" | tr -d '\000-\010\013\014\016-\037\177' | tr '\t\n\r' '   ' | sed -E 's/  +/ /g; s/^ //; s/ $//' | cut -c1-100; }

# --- resolve enabled flag -----------------------------------------------------
enabled="false"
if _kf_test_mode_active && [[ -n "${LOA_KF_SURFACE_TEST_CONFIG-}" ]]; then
  # In test mode the override stands in for the parsed config value.
  enabled="${LOA_KF_SURFACE_TEST_CONFIG}"
else
  config_path="${REPO_ROOT}/.loa.config.yaml"
  # No yq or no config -> the feature is opt-in and unconfigurable here: silent.
  if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ -f "$config_path" ]]; then
    # Explicit key, else the loa.profile default (cycle-129 D-9.1).
    # shellcheck source=scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh
    source "${REPO_ROOT}/.claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh" 2>/dev/null &&
      enabled="$(loa_knob known_failures.surface_at_session_start false 2>/dev/null || echo false)"
  fi
fi

# DISABLED (or unconfigurable) -> emit nothing, exit 0. This is the ONLY silent path.
[[ "$enabled" == "true" ]] || exit 0

# --- ENABLED: from here every exit is loud-or-table, always exit 0 -----------
KF_FILE="${REPO_ROOT}/grimoires/loa/known-failures.md"
if _kf_test_mode_active && [[ -n "${LOA_KNOWN_FAILURES_FILE:-}" ]]; then
  KF_FILE="${LOA_KNOWN_FAILURES_FILE}"
fi
# Test seam (mirrors loa-kf-surface.sh): overrides are honoured only under

  [[ "${LOA_DEC_SURFACE_TEST_MODE:-0}" == "1" ]] || return 1
  [[ -n "${BATS_TEST_FILENAME:-}" || -n "${BATS_VERSION:-}" ]]

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/profile-lib.bats — cycle-129 sprint-256 Task 2.7 (AC-2.9; PRD
# AC-9.1, AC-9.3; SDD D-9.1, D-9.3)
#
# .claude/data/profiles.yaml + .claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh: precedence
# (explicit key > profile > fallback), every profile defines every key,
# `standard` equals the oracle captured before any reader changed
# (tests/fixtures/profiles/standard-oracle.json), unknown profile, the
# mtime-keyed cache, the overrides line, the /loa Profile line, the readers
# that route through loa_knob, and the grep lint for direct reads.
# =============================================================================

bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0

setup() {
    R="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
    LIB="$R/.claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh"
    PROFILES="$R/.claude/data/profiles.yaml"
    ORACLE="$R/tests/fixtures/profiles/standard-oracle.json"
    T="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"
    CFG="$T/config.yaml"
    export LOA_PROFILE_CONFIG_FILE="$CFG"
    export LOA_PROFILE_CACHE_FILE="$T/run/effective-config.json"
    : > "$CFG"
}

knob() { bash "$LIB" knob "$@"; }

@test "PL-1 every profile defines every key, and the key set is the nine optional keys" {
    run diff <(yq -r '.profiles.lean | keys | .[]' "$PROFILES" | sort) <(jq -r '.keys | keys[]' "$ORACLE" | sort)
    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    for p in standard full; do
        run diff <(yq -r ".profiles.$p | keys | .[]" "$PROFILES" | sort) <(yq -r '.profiles.lean | keys | .[]' "$PROFILES" | sort)
        [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    done
    [ "$(yq -r '.profiles | keys | .[]' "$PROFILES" | sort | paste -sd, -)" = "full,lean,standard" ]
    [ "$(yq -r '.schema_version' "$PROFILES")" = "1" ]
    ! yq -r '.profiles[] | keys | .[]' "$PROFILES" | grep -qx 'interview.pacing'
}

@test "PL-2 every profile value is a boolean; lean is all false and full all true" {
    [ "$(yq -r '[.profiles[][] | tag] | unique | .[]' "$PROFILES")" = "!!bool" ]
    [ "$(yq -r '[.profiles.lean[]] | unique | .[]' "$PROFILES")" = "false" ]
    [ "$(yq -r '[.profiles.full[]] | unique | .[]' "$PROFILES")" = "true" ]
}

@test "PL-3 standard equals the oracle captured before any reader changed" {
    local k want got
    while IFS= read -r k; do
        want=$(jq -r --arg k "$k" '.keys[$k].standard' "$ORACLE")
        got=$(yq -r ".profiles.standard[\"$k\"]" "$PROFILES")
        [ "$want" = "$got" ] || { echo "standard $k = $got, oracle $want"; return 1; }
    done < <(jq -r '.keys | keys[]' "$ORACLE")
    # Outside the two guardrail keys (whose default this cycle changes) the
    # oracle's standard IS the value the readers returned for the shipped example.
    run jq -r '.keys | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("guardrails.") | not)
               | select(.value.standard != .value.example_today) | .key' "$ORACLE"
    [ -z "$output" ]
    run jq -r '.keys | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("guardrails.")) | "\(.value.example_today)/\(.value.standard)"' "$ORACLE"
    [ "$output" = "$(printf 'true/false\ntrue/false')" ]
}

@test "PL-4 standard equals the post-cycle example defaults (explicit example value, else the reader's fallback)" {
    local k ex st
    while IFS= read -r k; do
        ex=$(yq -r ".$k" "$R/.loa.config.yaml.example")
        st=$(yq -r ".profiles.standard[\"$k\"]" "$PROFILES")
        if [ "$ex" = "null" ]; then
            ex=$(jq -r --arg k "$k" '.keys[$k].empty_config_today' "$ORACLE")
        fi
        [ "$ex" = "$st" ] || { echo "example $k = $ex, standard $st"; return 1; }
    done < <(yq -r '.profiles.standard | keys | .[]' "$PROFILES")
    [ "$(yq -r '.loa.profile' "$R/.loa.config.yaml.example")" = "standard" ]
    # Under the example config the lib resolves standard and no override.
    LOA_PROFILE_CONFIG_FILE="$R/.loa.config.yaml.example" run bash "$LIB" overrides
    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    [ -z "$output" ]
}

@test "PL-5 precedence: explicit key beats the profile, the profile beats the fallback" {
    printf 'loa:\n  profile: lean\nknown_failures:\n  surface_at_session_start: true\nkarpathy_principles:\n  diff_lines_per_task: 250\n' > "$CFG"
    [ "$(knob known_failures.surface_at_session_start false)" = "true" ]     # explicit
    [ "$(knob decisions.surface_at_session_start true)" = "false" ]          # lean, not the fallback
    [ "$(knob karpathy_principles.surgical_diff_warning true)" = "false" ]   # lean
    [ "$(knob karpathy_principles.diff_lines_per_task 100)" = "250" ]        # non-profile key, explicit
    [ "$(knob run_mode.stale_hours 7)" = "7" ]                               # non-profile key, fallback
    printf 'loa:\n  profile: full\n' > "$CFG"
    [ "$(knob decisions.surface_at_session_start false)" = "true" ]
    : > "$CFG"
    [ "$(bash "$LIB" profile)" = "standard" ]
    [ "$(bash "$LIB" source)" = "default" ]
    [ "$(knob karpathy_principles.surgical_diff_warning false)" = "true" ]   # standard, not the fallback
}

head/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:631 — Fail-open regression in the FR-6 heredoc classifier. `_bdb_hd_same_line_exec` judges each `|`/`(`-split segment on its own, so a safe reader that names the heredoc target and pipes into a shell (`cat notes.txt | sh`, `source <(cat notes.txt)`, `sh -c "$(cat notes.txt)"`, `cat notes.txt | xargs …`) never counts as executing the target. The heredoc is classed nonexec and its body is cut down to fence-verb segments, so FR-SZ/FR-SZ2/FR-NOTES shapes in the body (cp/mv/ln/tee/sed -i into .claude/, etc.) are no longer scanned even though the same command runs them. Reproduced: `cat > notes.txt <<'EOF'⏎cp evil.sh .claude/hooks/pre.sh⏎EOF⏎cat notes.txt | sh` is blocked by base (FR-SZ2-COPY, exit 2) and allowed by head (exit 0). This is not the "later command" gap the header documents; it all happens in one command.
head/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:303 — `_bdb_hd_exec_dest` / `_bdb_hd_same_line_exec` miss implicit consumers that run a file without naming it: `cat > Makefile <<'EOF' … EOF⏎make` (also package.json + npm, .envrc + direnv, etc.). The body's non-fence-verb lines are dropped and the command passes. Reproduced: a Makefile recipe `cp evil.sh .claude/hooks/pre.sh` followed by `make` is blocked by base and allowed by head. A per-segment classifier that drops body text needs a deny-by-default list of executed config files, or should keep the full scan whenever the same command runs anything after the heredoc.
head/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:1063 — The classifier is on by default (`heredoc_classifier: true`) and replaces the #1245 scrub for every command that holds `<<`. Base only dropped a body for a standalone quoted `cat <<'W'` that was the entire command; head drops bodies in multi-statement commands too. Combined with the two holes above, this weakens the fence by default rather than leaving it opt-in, and no corpus row covers a nonexec heredoc that is later executed in the same command through a reader pipe or an implicit consumer.
head/.claude/scripts/run-checkpoint.sh:378 — `derive` breaks on jq 1.6. `--arg label` / `$label` (also at :380 and :389) is a syntax error there because `label` is a jq keyword ("unexpected label, expecting IDENT"). Every sprint row fails, `derive --json` exits 3, and the derive that `write` and `mark` run is silently swallowed. Reproduced with jq-1.6 here. The repo states no jq ≥ 1.7 floor, and the implement gate's deny mode, `/loa` and `/run-resume` step 0a all depend on derive. Rename the variable (e.g. `$lbl`).
head/.claude/scripts/run-checkpoint.sh:226 — `jq -e 'type == "object"' <<<"$pj" || pj='{}'` does not catch empty input on jq 1.6, which exits 0 with no output. For any feedback file without a LOA-VERDICT trailer (legacy files, or a reviewer that forgot the trailer), `pj` stays empty, `--argjson p ''` then fails, and `record-round` exits 2 instead of recording the round (reproduced). The same path runs for every sprint in `derive`. Test `[[ -n "$pj" ]]` explicitly.
head/.claude/scripts/run-checkpoint.sh:113 — Breaker and ledger come from the wrong root. When `--file F` is not inside a `.run/` directory, root and run_dir stay at the script's own checkout, so `write --file /tmp/x/state.json` derives from this repo's real ledger and rewrites this repo's real `.run/circuit-breaker.json` (and leaves a `.lock`), then stamps the foreign file with this repo's run state. Reproduced. Base `write` touched only `--file`. Derive should only run when F's directory is the run dir, or the breaker should be resolved next to F.
head/.claude/scripts/run-checkpoint.sh:456 — When no breaker exists, `derive --write` creates one through `atomic_update`, which feeds `{}`. `{}` is an object, so `merge_breaker`'s `skeleton` branch never runs and the file comes out as `{"triggers":{"cycle_count":{"current":0}},"state":"CLOSED"}`, with no thresholds, no limit and no `timeout.started`. `record-round` then accepts this file because `.triggers` is an object. The timeout trigger can never fire, and the status line prints `cycle 1/null, same_issue 1/null` (reproduced). Build the skeleton when the input has no `triggers` (as record-round does) or when the file is absent.
head/.claude/hooks/quality/karpathy-surgical-diff-check.sh:131 — The per-task key is not the current task. `run-checkpoint.sh write --task <id>` runs after `br close <id>` (implementing-tasks SKILL.md:211), and `read` only trusts a checkpoint whose task is closed, so `.checkpoint.task` is the last task finished. Lines written for task N+1 are stored under task N's file and summary, and the reviewer's SURGICAL axis (reviewing-code: `.run/karpathy-surgical/<bead>.jsonl`) blames the wrong bead. When br is unavailable or the task is not closed, `read` drops the checkpoint and the key falls back to `.sprint`, which turns this into a sprint-long total that warns on every write. Each Write/Edit also now runs `run-checkpoint.sh read`, which forks `br show`.
head/.claude/hooks/quality/karpathy-surgical-diff-check.sh:193 — The warning still says "Session diff total" although the total is now per task key. The message misstates what was measured.
head/.claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh:78 — The cache-key fallback is wrong on Linux. When any of config/profiles/floor is missing, GNU `stat -Lc` exits 1, and the BSD-form retry `stat -Lf '%N|%Fm|%z'` on GNU prints file-system status (free blocks, inodes) for the remaining files, not their mtime or size. That output is non-empty, so it becomes the cache id. Edits to the config then do not reliably invalidate `.run/effective-config.json`, and stale profile values are served. Reproduced: with floor.yaml absent, PL-5 fails because switching `loa.profile` lean→full keeps returning lean values. Detect the stat flavour once, or stat existing files only.
head/.claude/data/profiles.yaml:42 — `standard` sets `invisible_retrospective.enabled: true`, but before this change the postlude ran only on an explicit `true` (oracle `empty_config_today: false`, `this_repo_today: false`). Every config that omits the key, this repository included, now silently starts running the retrospective scan after each skill. The header claims the only default shifts are the two guardrail keys. Either pin the key in `.loa.config.yaml` / call it out as a migration item, or make `standard` false.
head/.claude/scripts/test-lint-invariants.sh:257 — The good-fixture assertions were loosened from exit 0 to "0 or 1" (also at :320, "exit 0 = all pass" now accepts warnings). Any new WARN on the clean fixture now passes unnoticed. The new invariant only emits PASS on that fixture, so nothing in this change needs the loosening. Restore the exit-0 assertion, or pin the exact expected WARNs.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED
